name: Md Omor Faruk
department: Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
bio:
I am a Ph.D. student and Graduate Research Assistant in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at the University of Wyoming, where I began my doctoral studies in Fall 2023.

My research goal is to develop an intelligent framework for Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA) that enables autonomous optimization of environmental parameters through the integration of Generative Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, and Reinforcement Learning.

I received my M.Eng. and B.Sc. Eng. degrees in Applied Physics & Electronic Engineering from the University of Rajshahi, Bangladesh, where I worked as a Research Assistant in the Wireless Communication Research Group from 2017 to 2023.
